cells.description: Unprivileged offline identity leg: re-hash staged bytes and re-check ELF/machine/type identity against the admission. Runs anywhere the toolchain runs.
cells.name: host-object-identity

cells.description: Unprivileged read-only capability survey: records kernel release, euid and bpffs/kvm/sysctl/tool probe evidence used for skip diagnosis. A measurement, never a gate.
cells.name: host-capability-probe

cells.description: Privileged live-load cell: loads the admitted object on the host kernel and runs BP semantic workloads. Blocked until a root/bpffs host plus bound BP workloads (TT05-full/TC07).
cells.name: host-bpf-load

cells.description: Owned QEMU guest cell (Debian 13 base): runs semantic reproducers isolated from the host kernel. Blocked until a guest image asset plus vng harness binding (TT05-full).
cells.name: owned-guest-debian13

cells.description: H33 valid-GPL helper-activity cell: a GPL-licensed object exercising helpers must load and show activity. Blocked until a privileged host plus GPL fixtures (TC07/TC08).
cells.name: host-license-gpl-activity

cells.description: H33 otherwise-valid non-GPL refusal cell: a non-GPL object must refuse at load with the license cause. Blocked until a privileged host plus non-GPL fixtures (TC07/TC08).
cells.name: host-license-nongpl-refusal

cells.description: H33 helper-free baseline cell: a helper-free object must load where permitted. Blocked until a privileged host plus baseline fixtures (TC07/TC08).
cells.name: host-license-helperfree-baseline
